jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Caselle builds specialized, enterprise ERP software for local government agencies. We are seeking a Director of Engineering to lead our teams in a hands-on role that blends technical depth with people leadership.

You will drive technical excellence and foster a culture of ownership, passion, and innovation, where engineers take pride in building great software and solving real customer problems. Central to the role is transforming how teams design, build, test, and ship by pioneering spec-driven development and embedding AI across the development lifecycle. Working closely with Product, QA, and other department leaders, you will define strategy, influence roadmaps, and ensure the quality delivery of impactful solutions.

You will oversee a dual-platform environment, supporting legacy desktop applications while driving long-term modernization toward a scalable, web-based architecture.

Reports to:
Chief Technology Officer

Location:
On-site / Hybrid

What You'll Do

People & Culture

Lead, mentor, and grow engineers across cross-functional teams, providing technical guidance, coaching, and career development.
Cultivate a culture of ownership, passion, innovation, and accountability, inspiring engineers to take pride in their craft and ship high-quality experiences.
Lead engineering hiring, from recruiting strategy through onboarding.

Technical Leadership & AI

Lead the integration of AI across the development lifecycle, from requirements through deployment, driving measurable gains in velocity, quality, and developer experience.
Champion spec-driven development with Product and QA leadership, establishing clear specifications as the source of truth for engineers and AI-assisted tooling.
Provide architectural and technical leadership, guiding design, reviewing code, and unblocking teams as needed.
Oversee both legacy and modern platforms, keeping existing systems stable while driving migration to web-based technologies, and partner with DevOps on reliability, performance, and security.

Delivery & Operations

Partner with Product Management to shape product strategy and roadmap decisions, and coordinate sprint and release planning with strong agile practices.
Define and track engineering KPIs, and establish processes, standards, and best practices that scale.
Own engineering metrics and report to the executive team on those metrics, project progress, risks, and tradeoffs.
Lead incident response and escalations, including customer-facing discussions, ensuring post-incident reviews drive lasting improvements.

What You'll Bring

10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading and scaling engineering teams.
A track record of shipping reliable, scalable web-based systems; experience modernizing legacy platforms is a strong plus.
Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on transforming the SDLC with AI.
Experience with spec-driven or specification-first development practices, partnering closely with Product and QA.
Strong architectural judgment with enough hands-on depth to review code and unblock teams.
Excellent communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven success recruiting, developing, and retaining engineering talent.

What Success Looks Like

Teams consistently deliver high-quality software on predictable timelines.
AI and spec-driven development are standard practice, measurably improving velocity, quality, and developer experience.
The platform is reliable, secure, and steadily modernizing toward a scalable, webbased architecture.
Engineering health is visible and improving, with the executive team confident in delivery, metrics, and progress.
The team is strong and growing, with a culture of ownership, passion, and innovation that attracts and retains top talent

jobs.title: Vice President of Data Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description
Pilot Dental Technologies develops PilotLMS, a comprehensive web-based laboratory management system built for dental labs that want to modernize operations and replace manual workflows. The platform streamlines administrative processes such as case entry, scanner portal integrations, billing, shipping, and client communication, helping labs work more efficiently. With extensive integrations to leading scanner portals, shipping carriers, and accounting systems, PilotLMS reduces repetitive data entry and improves case tracking and financial management. Dental labs choose PilotLMS for its transparent pricing, quick onboarding, intuitive interface, and advanced automation capabilities that are often missing from competing systems. The company’s mission is to let labs focus on creating exceptional prosthetics while providing accessible, enterprise-level functionality that supports scalable growth.
Role Description
The Vice President of Data Engineering is a full-time, remote leadership role responsible for shaping and executing Pilot Dental Technologies’ data strategy. This role oversees the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable data platforms and pipelines that power product functionality, analytics, and integrations across the PilotLMS ecosystem. The VP leads and mentors data engineering teams, establishes best practices, and collaborates closely with product, engineering, and operations stakeholders to ensure data reliability, security, and performance. Day-to-day responsibilities include aligning data architecture with business priorities, managing complex projects, optimizing data flows between internal services and external systems, and enabling advanced reporting and automation features for dental labs. The role also contributes to long-term technology roadmaps, evaluates new tools and approaches, and promotes a culture of continuous improvement and inclusive collaboration.
Qualifications

Demonstrated expertise in Engineering Management and Team Leadership, including building, mentoring, and scaling diverse, high-performing data engineering teams.
Strong Software Development skills with experience in modern data engineering stacks (e.g., cloud platforms, data warehouses, ETL/ELT tools, APIs, and integration frameworks).
Proven Project Management abilities, including planning, prioritizing, and delivering complex, cross-functional data initiatives on time and within scope.
Experience with Product Development, collaborating with product and engineering partners to translate business needs into data-driven features and capabilities.
Background in designing and operating data architectures (e.g., data lakes, event-driven systems, real-time pipelines) with a focus on scalability, reliability, and security.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and at least one programming language commonly used in data engineering (such as Python, Scala, or Java).
Familiarity with BI and analytics tools, and the ability to support data science, reporting, and performance monitoring efforts.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed environment.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Ontology Engineering, QDI
jobs.description:
Overview 

At QIAGEN, we are driven by a simple but powerful vision: making improvements in life possible.

We’re dedicated to revolutionizing science and healthcare for the better. From our entrepreneurial roots to our current global presence, we've grown into a force for positive change. With thousands of employees across six continents, collaboration is our greatest strength. We’re always striving to identify talented individuals to join our exceptional teams.

We have played a pivotal role in shaping modern science and healthcare, and we're just getting started. If you're someone who thrives on new challenges, values diversity and wants to make a tangible difference in people's lives, then QIAGEN is the place for you.

At QIAGEN, every day is an opportunity to make a real-life impact.

Join us, grow with us, and together, let's shape the future of biological discovery.

‎

About The Opportunity

QIAGEN Digital Insights is a leading provider of bioinformatics software and knowledge bases used by life scientists to gain insight from the molecular information in their biological samples. We have developed industry-leading software tools for analysis and reporting of biological data. We are passionate about our users, products, and our vision, and are seeking smart, motivated engineers and scientists who are eager to join our team in creating software that helps improve people's lives.

Located in Redwood City, CA, QIAGEN offers a professional work environment, competitive benefits, and values work-life balance.

As the Manager of Bioinformatics / Ontology Engineering, you will be managing a team of 7-10 bioinformaticians that are part of a collaborative, cross-functional team of scientists, bioinformaticians, knowledge engineers, and software engineers building powerful tools to gain biological insight into RNA-Seq and DNA-Seq data.

You will use your background in biological science and programming skills to assure the scientific quality of biological interpretations, supporting analytics, and information in our applications. We have built a world-class Knowledge Base rich with molecular and functional relationships derived from scientific literature and biological databases. In combination with our Knowledge Base, we use semantic technologies and other computational techniques to provide biological context to our analytics.

Your tasks include

Hands on management and development of creating new pipelines for content acquisition including targeted manual curation and automated processing of structured and unstructured biological data.
Work collaboratively with the other teams to make decisions on content modeling and integration for all QIAGEN products and services.
Contribute to quality control and reliability efforts for our processes, pipelines, tools, and models that support development, build, and maintenance of our biological content.
Review and refine data and software requirements, use cases, and workflows for product features to ensure that they are scientifically valid, technically robust, and testable.

Your profile

Domain knowledge evidenced by a graduate degree and applied experience in genetics, molecular biology, bioinformatics, or related field.
Familiarity with bioinformatics tools in genome biomedical research (e.g., genomic databases, genome browsers, mutation repositories), or integrative data analysis as it relates to genetics, multiomics, cell biology, physiology and pathology.
Proven ability to solve problems using programming skills, especially in Python, Perl, or Java. 5+ years of experience or formal or advanced training preferred.
Experience with database design and programming (e.g. PostgreSQL, Oracle, Neo4j).

Preferred (one Or More Of The Following)

7-10 yrs hands-on experience developing bioinformatics data pipelines including testing and deployment to production systems.
7-10 years management experience of software and bioinformatics engineers, QA engineers, and strong agile process management.
Experience in working with formalized Quality Assurance (QA) processes within a Quality Management System (QMS).
Strong understanding of medical genetics, pharmacogenetics, molecular pathology, or oncology.
Knowledge of information extraction (IE), data integration, ontology, semantic technology, machine learning (ML), or natural language processing (NLP).
Knowledge of software development best practices, quality controls, testing techniques.

The estimated base salary range for this position is $180,000 - $235,000. Compensation will be based on the candidate’s experience, skills, geographic location, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, we offer a total compensation package that includes a bonus plan and generous benefits.

What We Offer 

Bonus/Commission
Local benefits
Referral Program
Volunteer Day
Internal Academy (QIALearn)
Employee Assistance Program
Hybrid work (conditional to your role)

Our people are the heartbeat of everything we do. Passion drives us as we push boundaries to innovate and evolve. We inspire with our leadership and make an impact with our actions. We cultivate a collaborative, supportive environment where each individual and team can flourish. We champion accountability and encourage entrepreneurial thinking.  

QIAGEN is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran, or disability.

jobs.description:
Since 1985, Kinsley Steel has been delivering unmatched quality steel on time and on budget. Our certified and highly-skilled teams specialize in structural steel design, engineering, detailing, fabrication, erection and retrofit to existing structural members.

The Director of Information Technology
is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building and executing the technology strategy that will support Kinsley Steel's next phase of growth. This role oversees the IT while remaining directly engaged in day-to-day technical decisions, architecture, and problem-solving.

This role partners closely with executive leadership to translate business goals into a technology roadmap, and serves as the primary escalation point for complex technical, security, and infrastructure decisions.

Leadership & Team Management

Directly supervise, mentor, and develop the IT team, setting clear priorities, performance goals, and professional development plans.
Remain hands-on with critical technical work, escalated issues, and complex projects where senior-level expertise and architecture knowledge is required, rather than operating purely at a strategic level.
Build department structure, workflows, and documentation standards appropriate for a growing, multi-location organization.
Own the IT budget, including forecasting, capital planning, and cost optimization across all locations.
Negotiate and manage contracts with technology vendors, managed service providers, and software partners.

Strategy & Business Alignment

Partner with Kinsley Steel business leadership to define and execute a multi-year technology roadmap that supports the company's growth strategy.
Identify and evaluate emerging technologies - including automation and AI - that can create efficiencies across estimating, detailing, fabrication, project management, and back-office functions.
Serve as the key technology advisor to the business leadership as well as in strategic planning and capacity planning discussions.
Oversee the delivery of end-user services, including help desk and technical support services.

AI Strategy & Governance

Develop and lead the company's approach to responsible AI adoption, identifying practical use cases, evaluating, and piloting AI-enabled tools.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

Own and modernize the company's overall cybersecurity strategy, including network security, endpoint protection, identity and access management, and data protection.
Establish and maintain security policies, incident response plans, and disaster recovery/business continuity procedures across all locations.

Enterprise Systems & Infrastructure

Own the performance, integration, and roadmap for key business systems ensuring they effectively support the business.
Oversee network architecture, servers, cloud infrastructure, end-user devices, and business applications across all locations.
Provide technical leadership in key technologies including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, ERP/manufacturing/project systems, and data platforms.
Evaluate, select, and implement new hardware, software, and infrastructure solutions to support business efficiency and scalability.

Qualifications

Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in information technology, including at least 5 years in a leadership or management role overseeing IT staff and strategy.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Demonstrated experience leading cybersecurity strategy, including security frameworks, incident response, and disaster recovery planning; relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, Security+) preferred.
Experience evaluating or implementing AI tools and establishing governance, data use, or acceptable-use policies a strong plus.
Hands-on experience with enterprise networking (Cisco/Meraki), Active Directory, Microsoft 365, virtualization (VMWare/Hyper-V), and backup/recovery solutions (e.g., Veeam).
Experience with, or strong aptitude for, construction or manufacturing-related software such as Trimble Viewpoint, Tekla, and AutoDesk strongly preferred.
Proven experience managing IT budgets, vendor contracts, and supplier negotiations.
Strong leadership, coaching, and team-development skills, with the ability to remain hands-on with technical work as needed.
Excellent analytical, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities across locations.
Strong oral and written communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical business leaders.
Ability to travel periodically to other company locations.
Valid Driver's License required.

I. Technology Strategy and Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the company's global technology strategy aligned with corporate vision and long-term business objectives.
Define enterprise technology roadmaps covering software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, and digital platforms.
Provide strategic technology leadership to support business growth, operational excellence, and competitive differentiation.
Advise the CEO and executive leadership team on emerging technologies, technology investments, and innovation opportunities.

Lead global software engineering, systems engineering, platform development, infrastructure engineering, and technical operations teams.

Promote enterprise-wide collaboration to accelerate innovation and strategic execution.

Build and lead a world-class global technology organization.

Establish engineering excellence, technology governance, and organizational best practices.

7-10 years management experience of software and bioinformatics engineers, QA engineers, and strong agile process management.
Experience in working with formalized Quality Assurance (QA) processes within a Quality Management System (QMS).

Job Title

Executive Vice President of Technology

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Executive Vice President of Technology is responsible for leading the company’s global technology strategy, engineering organization, technology operations, digital innovation, and enterprise architecture. This executive role oversees the development, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support business growth, product innovation, operational excellence, and long-term competitiveness.

The EVP of Technology serves as a key member of the executive leadership team, driving enterprise-wide technology transformation while ensuring alignment between technology investments, business strategy, product development, cybersecurity, and digital innovation. This role collaborates closely with Product Management, R&D, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate Strategy teams to accelerate innovation and deliver scalable technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
I. Technology Strategy and Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the company's global technology strategy aligned with corporate vision and long-term business objectives.
Define enterprise technology roadmaps covering software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, and digital platforms.
Provide strategic technology leadership to support business growth, operational excellence, and competitive differentiation.
Advise the CEO and executive leadership team on emerging technologies, technology investments, and innovation opportunities.

II. Technology Development and Engineering Management

Lead global software engineering, systems engineering, platform development, infrastructure engineering, and technical operations teams.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise technology solutions.
Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, architecture governance, and quality assurance processes.
Promote Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, and continuous delivery best practices.

III. Digital Transformation and Innovation

Lead enterprise digital transformation initiatives across business functions.
Drive adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Cloud Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), automation, big data analytics, and emerging technologies.
Identify new technology opportunities that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and business performance.
Foster a culture of continuous innovation and technology excellence.

IV. Enterprise Architecture and Technology Operations

Develop enterprise architecture strategies that ensure scalability, security, and interoperability across technology ecosystems.
Oversee IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, data platforms, and technology operations.
Ensure technology systems maintain high availability, reliability, performance, and business continuity.
Optimize technology governance, system integration, and infrastructure utilization.

V. Cybersecurity, Compliance, and Risk Management

Develop enterprise cybersecurity strategies and information security governance frameworks.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and data privacy regulations.
Establish technology risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans.
Continuously monitor cybersecurity threats and implement proactive mitigation strategies.

VI. Technology Performance and Financial Management

Develop and manage the global technology budget, capital investments, and operational expenditures.
Optimize technology investments to maximize business value and return on investment (ROI).
Establish technology performance metrics, engineering KPIs, system reliability indicators, and operational dashboards.
Drive continuous improvement in technology efficiency, productivity, and cost management.

VII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Product Management, R&D, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, and Customer Support teams.
Ensure technology strategy supports product innovation, commercialization, customer success, and operational objectives.
Support mergers, acquisitions, system integrations, and global expansion initiatives.
Promote enterprise-wide collaboration to accelerate innovation and strategic execution.

VIII. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a world-class global technology organization.
Develop leadership capabilities, succession planning, and technical talent development programs.
Establish engineering excellence, technology governance, and organizational best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18+ years of experience in technology leadership, software engineering, information technology, systems architecture, or digital transformation, including 8+ years in executive management positions.

Proven track record of leading large-scale global technology organizations and delivering enterprise technology transformation.
